tags.name: Client Downloads
tags.description: Download client libraries for Java and Python

get.description: Download the Java client JAR for this REST API

200.description: Java client JAR file

500.description: Internal server error

get.description: Download the Python client ZIP for this REST API

200.description: Python client ZIP file

500.description: Internal server error

get.description: Returns information about available client libraries for download

200.description: Client information retrieved successfully

get.summary: Returns a list of all available CCS Prediction models

200.description: Request accepted.

500.description: An internal server error occured.

post.summary: Predict CCS value for a given structure
post.description: This endpoint predicts a CCS (Collision Cross Section) value for a given structure. It uses the CCS-Predict model specified by the 'modelId' path parameter. The model is retrieved from the Model Meta Information, which can be obtained through the '/ccspredict/models' endpoint. Please copy the structure type identifiers from the Model Meta Information.

200.description: Request accepted

500.description: An internal server error occured.

post.summary: Generate new EICs and EIMs for a specific Feature Table
post.description: This operation generates new Extracted Ion Chromatograms (EICs) and Extracted Ion Mobilograms (EIMs) for a specific Feature Table identified by the 'featureTableId' path parameter. The 'featureIds' parameter specifies the features for which the EICs and EIMs are to be generated.

parameters.name: featureTableId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Feature Table for which the EICs and EIMs are to be generated.

requestBody.description: The identifiers of the features for which the EICs and EIMs are to be generated.

201.description: Successful operation, the new EICs and EIMs are generated.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

get.summary: Retrieve EICs for a specific feature
get.description: This operation retrieves Extracted Ion Chromatograms (EICs) for a specific feature identified by the 'featureId' path parameter.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the feature for which the EICs are to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful operation, the EICs for the specified feature are retrieved.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

get.summary: Retrieve EIMs for a specific feature
get.description: This operation retrieves Extracted Ion Mobilograms (EIMs) for a specific feature identified by the 'featureId' path parameter.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the feature for which the EIMs are to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful operation, the EIMs for the specified feature are retrieved.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

post.description: This operation initiates the creation of an experiment by processing the provided project YAML. This YAML should define the project id and details about the experiment and feature table to be created.

requestBody.description: The YAML file that references a project, and defines the structure of one experiment and one Feature Table. The Project ID is mandatory to create an experiment!

202.description: Data processing task succesfully initiated. The response will include details (names and identifiers) about the created project, associated experiments, feature tables, and the ID of the started task.

500.description: Internal server error. This can be due to invalid YAML structure, server misconfiguration, or other unexpected issues.

post.summary: Create a new experiment from project id and experiment definition
post.description: This operation initiates the creation of an experiment by processing the provided ExperimentDefinition object. The ExperimentDefinition should define the experiment's structure, including details about feature tables. The Project ID is mandatory to create an experiment.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The ID of the project to which the experiment belongs.

requestBody.description: The ExperimentDefinition object that defines the structure and details of the experiment, including feature tables.

202.description: Experiment successfully initiated. The response will include details (names and identifiers) about the created experiment, associated feature tables, and the ID of the started task.

500.description: Internal server error. This can be due to invalid experiment definition, server misconfiguration, or other unexpected issues.

post.summary: Create a new Feature Table based on a project file
post.description: This operation creates a new Feature Table based on the details provided in the 'projectFile' parameter. The returned data is in JSON format.

requestBody.description: The YAML file that references a project and experiment, and defines the structure of one Feature Table. The Project ID and Experiment ID are mandatory to create a Feature Table!

202.description: Successful operation, returns a 'ProjectTaskSummary' object with details about the created Feature Table.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

post.summary: Create a new feature table from project id, experiment id and feature table definition
post.description: This operation initiates the creation of a feature table by processing the provided FeatureTable object. The Project ID and Experiment ID are mandatory to create a feature table.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The ID of the project to which the feature table belongs.

parameters.name: experimentId
parameters.description: The ID of the experiment to which the feature table belongs.

requestBody.description: The FeatureTable object that defines the structure and details of the feature table.

202.description: Feature table successfully initiated. The response will include details (names and identifiers) about the created feature table and the ID of the started task.

500.description: Internal server error. This can be due to invalid feature table definition, server misconfiguration, or other unexpected issues.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific Feature based on its ID
get.description: This operation retrieves a specific Feature identified by the 'featureId' path parameter. The returned data is in JSON format.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Feature to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful operation, returns the Feature of the specified ID.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

get.summary: Fetches a specific Feature Table based on its ID
get.description: This operation fetches a specific Feature Table identified by the 'featureTableId' path parameter. The returned data is in JSON format and contains an array of 'Feature' objects.

parameters.name: featureTableId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Feature Table to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful operation, returns an array of 'Feature' objects belonging to the specified Feature Table.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

get.summary: Retrieve a intensity matrix of a Feature Table based on its ID
get.description: Retrieve the intensity matrix of a Feature Table (i.e. a 2D array of intensities with dimensions based on the indices of Features and Analyses) identified by the 'featureTableId' path parameter. The returned data is in JSON format.

parameters.name: featureTableId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Feature Table whose intensity matrix is to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful operation, returns the intensity matrix of the specified Feature Table.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

post.summary: Create a custom annotation for a specific feature
post.description: With this operation, an annotation from any custom annotation outside of MetaboScape can be created for a Feature with a given 'featureId'. The 'candidate' parameter specifies the annotation candidate to be created. The annotation tool will be defined as "External" in MetaboScape.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the feature for which the annotation is to be created.

requestBody.description: The annotation candidate to be created.

201.description: Successful operation, the annotation is created.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

post.summary: Delete a specific annotation for a specific feature
post.description: This operation deletes a specific annotation for a specific feature identified by the 'featureId' path parameter. The parameter 'annotationId' determines the annotation to be deleted. Not all annotations for the feature are deleted.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the feature for which the annotation is to be deleted.

parameters.name: annotationId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the annotation to be deleted.

204.description: Successful operation, the annotation is deleted.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

get.description: This operation retrieves an Annotation Configuration identified by the 'configurationId' path parameter.

parameters.name: configurationId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Annotation Configuration to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful operation, the Annotation Configuration is retrieved.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

post.summary: Save a new Annotation Configuration for a specific Feature Table
post.description: This operation saves a new Annotation Configuration for a specific Feature Table identified by the 'featureTableId' path parameter. The 'config' parameter specifies the Annotation Configuration to be saved.

parameters.name: featureTableId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Feature Table for which the Annotation Configuration is to be saved.

requestBody.description: The Annotation Configuration to be saved.

200.description: Successful operation, the new Annotation Configuration is saved and the Annotation Configuration UUID provided.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

post.summary: Create Lipid Species Annotations with Method
post.description: This operation creates Lipid Species Annotations using a specific method identified by the 'annotationMethodUuid' path parameter.

parameters.name: annotationMethodUuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the method for which the Lipid Species Annotations are to be created.

200.description: Successful operation, the Lipid Species Annotations are created.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

post.description: This operation creates SmartFormula Annotations using a specific method identified by the 'annotationMethodUuid' path parameter.

parameters.name: annotationMethodUuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the method for which the SmartFormula Annotations are to be created.

requestBody.description: The main ion details for the annotations.

200.description: Successful operation, the SmartFormula Annotations are created.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

post.summary: Create Target List Annotations with Method
post.description: This operation creates Target List Annotations using a specific method identified by the 'annotationMethodUuid' path parameter.

parameters.name: annotationMethodUuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the method for which the Target List Annotations are to be created.

200.description: Successful operation, the Target List Annotations are created.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

get.summary: Retrieve Annotation Methods by Tool ID
get.description: This operation retrieves Annotation Methods for a specific tool identified by the 'toolId' path parameter ('TL' for Target List, 'LS' for Lipid Species, 'SL' for Spectral Library, 'SF' for SmartFormula).

parameters.name: toolId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tool for which the Annotation Methods are to be retrieved. ('TL' for Target List, 'LS' for Lipid Species, 'SL' for Spectral Library, 'SF' for SmartFormula)

200.description: Successful operation, the Annotation Methods for the specified tool are retrieved.

400.description: Bad Request, the provided 'toolId' is not recognized or invalid. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

post.description: This operation adds a flag to a specific feature identified by the 'featureId' path parameter.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the feature to which the flag is to be added.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: The flag to be added to the feature.

204.description: Successful operation, the flag is added to the feature.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

post.description: This operation removes a flag from a specific feature identified by the 'featureId' path parameter.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the feature from which the flag is to be removed.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: The flag to be removed from the feature.

204.description: Successful operation, the flag is removed from the feature.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

post.description: This operation initiates the creation of a project by processing the provided project YAML. This YAML should define the project's structure, including details about experiments and feature tables.

requestBody.description: The YAML file that defines the structure and details of the project, including one experiment and one Feature Table.

202.description: Project successfully initiated. The response will include details (names and identifiers) about the created project, associated experiments, feature tables, and the ID of the started task.

500.description: Internal server error. This can be due to invalid YAML structure, server misconfiguration, or other unexpected issues.

post.summary: Create a new project from project definition
post.description: This operation initiates the creation of a project by processing the provided ProjectDefinition object. The ProjectDefinition should define the project's structure, including details about experiments and feature tables.

requestBody.description: The ProjectDefinition object that defines the structure and details of the project, including one experiment and one feature table.

202.description: Project successfully initiated. The response will include details (names and identifiers) about the created project, associated experiments, feature tables, and the ID of the started task.

500.description: Internal server error. This can be due to invalid project definition, server misconfiguration, or other unexpected issues.

get.description: This endpoint provides the current status of a project task. Clients are advised to poll this endpoint every minute until the task status reaches 'done', 'canceled' or 'failed'.

parameters.name: workflowTaskId
parameters.description: ID of the project task to retrieve its status.

202.description: The task is still in processing. The response includes the name and ID of the ongoing task.

200.description: The task has completed, either successfully or with errors. The response includes the name and ID of the completed task.

500.description: An internal server error occurred.

get.description: This operation retrieves a list of all projects. The 'creationDate' fields are returned in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-08-06T07:05:44.670Z) for projects, experiments, and feature tables.

200.description: Successful operation, the list of all projects is retrieved.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

get.description: This operation retrieves a project identified by the 'projectId' path parameter. The 'creationDate' fields are returned in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-08-06T07:05:44.670Z) for the project, its experiments, and feature tables.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the project to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful operation, the project is retrieved.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

get.description: This operation retrieves information about a project identified by the 'projectId' path parameter.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the project for which the information is to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful operation, the project information is retrieved.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

get.description: This operation retrieves a list of all samples for a specific feature table identified by the 'featureTableId' path parameter.

parameters.name: featureTableId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the feature table for which the samples are to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful operation, the list of all samples is retrieved.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

put.description: This operation updates the volume information for one or more samples in a project identified by the 'projectId' path parameter.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the project for which the sample volumes are to be updated.

requestBody.description: An array of sample volume update requests containing sample IDs, and volumes.

204.description: Successful operation, the sample volumes have been updated.

400.description: Bad request. The request body is invalid or contains missing required fields.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

get.description: This operation retrieves a consensus MS Spectrum for every ion of a Feature identified by the 'featureId' path parameter.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the feature for which the Feature Ion MS Spectra are to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful operation, the Feature Ion MS Spectra are retrieved.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

get.description: This operation retrieves an MS/MS spectrum (if available) for every ion of a specific feature identified by the 'featureId' path parameter.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the feature for which the Feature MS/MS Spectra are to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful operation, the Feature MS/MS Spectra are retrieved.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

get.description: This operation retrieves a deisotoped MS/MS spectrum (if available) for every ion of a specific feature identified by the 'featureId' path parameter.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the feature for which the Feature MS/MS Deisotoped Spectra are to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful operation, the Feature MS/MS Deisotoped Spectra are retrieved.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

get.description: This operation retrieves MS Spectra for every analysis of a specific Feature identified by the 'featureId' parameter.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the feature for which the Feature MS Spectra Details are to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful operation, the Feature MS Spectra Details are retrieved.

500.description: An internal server error occurred. Returns an 'ErrorResponse' object with details about the error.

creationDate.description: Creation date of the experiment in ISO 8601 format
Creation date of the feature table in ISO 8601 format
Creation date of the project in ISO 8601 format

path.description: The path to the analysis directory.

sample.description: The sample associated with the analysis directory.

AnalysisDirectoryDefinition.description: The list of analysis directories associated with the feature table.

AnnotationMethodsDefinition.description: The annotation methods used for the feature table.

id.description: The unique identifier of the experiment. This will be generated by the system.

samples.description: The list of samples associated with the experiment.

featureTables.description: The list of feature tables associated with the experiment.

ExperimentDefinition.description: The list of experiments associated with the project.

name.description: The name of the feature table.

polarity.description: The polarity of the feature table, e.g., positive or negative.

workflowKey.description: The workflow key associated with the feature table, eg, LC-QTOF, LC-TIMS-QTOF, LC-MRMS, MRMS-Single, MALDI, MALDI-TIMS

analysisDirectories.description: The list of analysis directories associated with the feature table.

eicEimGeneration.description: Flag indicating whether EIC/EIM generation is enabled.

FeatureTableDefinition.description: The list of feature tables associated with the experiment.

group.description: The group to which the features belong.

quantity.description: The quantity of features in the group.

type.description: The type of quantity, either 'PERCENTAGE' or 'ABSOLUTE'.

FeaturesInSampleGroupDefinition.description: The list of features in sample groups. This is only allowed when groups are defined.

minimumFeaturesForExtraction.description: The minimum number of features required for extraction.

minimumAnalysesWithFeatures.description: The minimum number of analyses that must have features.

presenceOfFeaturesInSampleGroup.description: The list of features in sample groups. This is only allowed when groups are defined.

FiltersDefinition.description: The filters applied to the feature table.

ImagingDataDefinition.description: The imaging data associated with the feature table.

MethodAttributesDefinition.description: Annotation attributes for the annotation method.

ProcessingMethodsDefinition.description: The processing methods used for the feature table. Excatly one T-ReX method is required and the the IonDeconvolution method is mandatory.

regionDefinitionFile.description: The file defining the regions of interest.

dataSources.description: The list of data sources for the regions of interest.

items.description: The list of data sources for the regions of interest.

RegionsOfInterestDefinition.description: The regions of interest for the imaging data.

maxSpecklesPerRoI.description: The maximum number of speckles per region of interest (RoI).

intensityThreshold.description: The intensity threshold for the speckles.

RoISubsamplingDefinition.description: The subsampling parameters for the regions of interest.

type.description: The type of the sample. Available Selections: sample, qualityControl, blank, calibrant

groups.description: The list of groups associated with the sample.

SampleDefinition.description: The list of samples associated with the experiment.

name.description: The name of the sample group.

attribute.description: The attribute of the sample group.

SampleGroupDefinition.description: The list of groups associated with the sample.

width.description: the peak width at the given m/z and intensity (can be 0 for MS/MS spectra)

name.description: The name of the group attribute.

color.description: The color of the group attribute. Allowed values: red, green, blue, pink, violet, orange, brown, black.

symbol.description: The symbol of the group attribute. Allowed values: circle, triangle, cross, plus, rhombus, triangle down, square.

GroupAttributeDefinition.description: The list of attributes associated with the group.

attributes.description: The list of attributes associated with the group.

GroupDefinition.description: The list of groups associated with the project.

id.description: The unique identifier of the project. This will be generated by the system.

groups.description: The list of groups associated with the project.

experiments.description: The list of experiments associated with the project.

include.description: Indicates whether this analysis is included in the feature table processing

Analysis.description: Represents an analysis with metadata including name, inclusion status, identifier, and file location information

path.description: The file path where the analysis data is stored

stationName.description: The human-readable name of the station where the analysis data is located.

FilePathInfo.description: File path information containing the station name and where the analysis data is located

sampleId.description: The unique identifier of the sample
